messages:
Alex: heads-up — the curl snippet under docs/runtime-api is returning 404 against staging. ran this locally and got a Not Found. snippet: 

```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{ "model": "open-llama", "prompt": "hello" }'
```

Response: `404 Not Found`. Prod works. anyone on docs ownership able to pick this up? @Maria

Maria: on it. will try to repro & open a tiny PR if it's just the example path. ETA ~30m.

Jordan: FYI infra changed route prefixes last week (we moved some text endpoints under `/v1/text/*`). could be that. pinging infra for confirmation. we might want to canonicalize the example to `/v1/text/generate`.

Alex: good call. if we change the example, can we add a short note showing the legacy path + redirect suggestion? some customers still hit the old endpoint.

DocsBot: [deploy-bot] docs staging build 7a3d succeeded 15:10 UTC — no changes deployed yet for this PR.

Sam: I can handle the redirect in the gateway once Jordan confirms which legacy paths need 301 -> new path.

Jordan: confirmed — routing team will add 301s for `/v1/generate` -> `/v1/text/generate` and `/v1/embeddings` -> `/v1/vector/embeddings`. no infra blockers. Sam please coordinate with me on the ingress PR.

Maria: opened PR #4825: updates curl sample to `/v1/text/generate`, adds a one-line note about legacy path + redirect, and adds a quick unit test for the snippet. requesting @Alex for review.

Alex: looking now. small wording nit on the note, else LGTM. will merge after CI. :thumbsup:

Maria: thanks — I'll watch staging once merged and close the loop here.

Sam: noted — will merge ingress redirect after docs PR lands.

Alex: perfect. thanks all.
